The '''Battle of Dantooine''' was a conflict on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] at the tail end of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the war came to a close with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Republic commanders on Dantooine refused to comply to the conditions set forth in the Treaty. They instead continued the battle, making it one of the first in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that arose in the aftermath of the Great Galactic War. While Republic military commanders engaged Imperial forces openly, members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and other agents worked to lure [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leaders into a trap in Dantooine's [[Crystal Cave (Dantooine)|Crystal Cave]]. During the battle the Republic privateer [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zale Barrows]] and his [[Free Spacers Fleet]] defeated the [[Imperial Third Fleet]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
